findings.reason: The evidence shows a temporal correlation and rollback, but does not prove the configuration was 'faulty' or definitively the cause.
T3 and T1 explicitly show the RRC drop onset at 06:15 and drop rate spike onset at 06:30 for S-SAH-010.
T5 and CHG-2026-0082 confirm the config_push of OPT-21 to S-SAH-010 at 06:26.
T4 states 'No critical or major alarm in this window' for the specified nodes and descendants.
T6 explicitly reports no maintenance windows for the specified nodes and ancestors in the given time window.
T3 shows KPI recovery at 13:45, T4 shows alarm clearance at 13:42/13:46, and CHG-2026-0085 shows rollback at 13:40.
